cells.Set by: `bin/ci/tron-build/test_benchmark_runtime.py`, for a test. No workflow sets it.
cells.Values and default: Absolute path of a directory. The helper `ci-shared-nfs.sh ensure-dir` rejects a relative path and a symbolic link. It creates a missing directory and sets the mode to `777`. Unset: `/scratch/test/cache`.
cells.Effect: `run_benchmark.sh` (the CI benchmark script) keeps each result here as `benchmark.<result identity>.json`. When that regular file exists, the script copies it to the result path. It does not measure again. The option `--force` removes the cached file and measures again. Job `benchmark` passes `--force` on the second and later run attempts. The result identity is a SHA-256 hash of the payload identity, the source hash, the machine class and the host identity.

cells.Read by: `benchmark_save.py` (`bin/ci/benchmark_save.py`). The function `golden_trace_dir` in `bin/ci/benchmark_lib.py` also reads it, and no code calls that function.
cells.Values and default: Path of an existing directory. `benchmark_save.py` does not create the directory and does not check the path. Unset: `/scratch/tron-benchmark`. Empty: `benchmark_save.py` uses the empty text, and the result file path starts at the root directory `/`.
cells.Effect: `bin/ci/benchmark_save.py` (the script that runs benchmarks and saves the samples) reads and writes its result file in this directory. The file name is `<commit>.<host name>.json`, with the first 7 characters of the commit. The script loads an existing file and skips configurations that already have enough samples. `bin/ci/tron-build/run_benchmark.sh` overwrites it with the value of `TRON_BENCHMARK_RESULTS_ROOT`, or with `/scratch/tron-benchmark` when that variable is unset. `benchmark-golden.yml` sets `/scratch/tron-benchmark-golden`. `ci-run-benchmark.sh`, `benchmark_info.py` and `generate_benchmark_report.sh` use fixed paths under `/scratch`. They do not read the variable. A missing directory makes the first save fail.

cells.Set by: `bin/ci/tron-build/test_benchmark_runtime.py`, for a test. No workflow sets it.
cells.Values and default: Any non-empty text. The script uses it in a file name and as one input of a hash. A new measurement succeeds only when the text equals the host name. Unset: the output of the `hostname` command.
cells.Effect: `run_benchmark.sh` names the result file `<git sha7>.<host identity>.json`. The text is also one input of the result identity (the hash that names the cached result file). `benchmark_save.py` does not read this variable. It names its output file with `socket.gethostname()`. After a measurement, `run_benchmark.sh` copies `<git sha7>.<host identity>.json` to the cache. With a value that differs from the host name, this copy finds no file and the script fails.

cells.Set by: `bin/ci/tron-build/test_benchmark_runtime.py`, for a test. No workflow sets it.
cells.Values and default: Path or command name of a Python program. The script runs the text as a command. Unset: `$TRON_BENCHMARK_ENVIRONMENT/bin/python3`.
cells.Effect: `run_benchmark.sh` runs `benchmark_runtime.py result-identity` and `benchmark_save.py --grid --prebuilt` with this Python program. `run_benchmark.sh` still requires `TRON_BENCHMARK_ENVIRONMENT` when this variable is set.

cells.Set by: `bin/ci/tron-build/test_benchmark_runtime.py`, for a test. No workflow sets it.
cells.Values and default: Absolute path of a directory. The helper `ci-shared-nfs.sh ensure-dir` rejects a relative path and a symbolic link. It creates a missing directory and sets the mode to `777`. Unset: `/scratch/tron-benchmark`.
cells.Effect: The result file of `run_benchmark.sh` is `<value>/<git sha7>.<host identity>.json`. The script exports the same directory as `TRON_BENCHMARK_DIR` for `benchmark_save.py`. `generate_benchmark_report.sh` reads the fixed directory `/scratch/tron-benchmark`. It does not read this variable. Before a measurement, `run_benchmark.sh` removes an existing result file of the same name.

cells.Read by: No program at run time. Only the function `golden_trace_dir` reads it (`bin/ci/benchmark_lib.py`), and no code in the checkout calls that function.
cells.Set by: Nothing in the checkout sets it.
cells.Values and default: Path of a directory. The function returns a non-empty value unchanged. Unset: the function returns `<TRON_BENCHMARK_DIR>/traces`. When `TRON_BENCHMARK_DIR` is also unset or empty, it returns `/scratch/tron-benchmark/traces`.
cells.Effect: No effect at run time in this checkout. The function `golden_trace_dir` in `bin/ci/benchmark_lib.py` returns the value as the root directory for Perfetto traces of the golden benchmark (the nightly benchmark of the workflow `benchmark-golden.yml`). No code calls that function. An empty value counts as unset. The function comment gives the layout `<host>/<sha7>/<workload-slug>/<repeat>.perfetto-trace` below the directory. `<sha7>` is the first 7 characters of the commit.

cells.Where: Nothing in Tron. `bin/ci/test_run_cargo_test_binary.py` sets it for the shell that runs `rust/run-cargo-test-binary`.
cells.What Tron does with it: One CI test sets it. `cd` in `rust/run-cargo-test-binary` then prints the directory name. The test expects the error `expected exactly one test executable, found 0` and no `JSONDecodeError`.

cells.Where: `perfetto/tronperf`, `perfetto/wrapper`, `bin/scratch-dir.sh` and 20 more files. Python tools such as `bin/slice` and `bin/dice-lsf-submit` read it through `Path.home()`.
cells.What Tron does with it: It is the base of default paths. `perfetto/tronperf` writes `$HOME/runtron.trace`. `perfetto/wrapper` writes `$HOME/sigusr1.trace`. `bin/dice-lsf-submit` uses `~/dice-lsf/jobs` as its default job directory. `bin/bsub-build` passes it to the remote build job. Nix builds set `$TMPDIR/home`.
